name: Drum and bass double drop
lesson:
## Thirty-two bars of overlap, one bass

B enters on A's second drop section with its low cut, up to full in 8 bars, and both faders sit at full for 32 bars. On the one of bar 33 the two drops land together and the bass swaps in half a bar so B owns the sub. A leaves over bars 41 to 49.

At 174 BPM everything is twice as fast, which is why DnB DJs cut lows hard rather than fading them: two sub-basses at once is a wall of mud. The score is the swap: half a bar, never both above half. Both tracks need their drops on 32-bar boundaries, and they must be in a compatible key or the double drop is a clash.

tracks.cue: A on its first drop (the third 16-bar phrase). B enters on the second drop section.
Both 9B: cue B so its drop lands 32 bars after B's fader comes up; on bar 33 the two drops hit and B's bass takes over in half a bar.
Alternative B in 8B: cue on the first beat of its drop.
